cues.text: At Naganaki Shrine, Maiko and you stand by a climbing frame. A thin young man in a striped suit walks up to you, one hand gripping his other arm.
Maiko huffs and runs a few steps away from him.
Maiko comes running back and stops beside the young man.
The thin young man turns and walks away.
The thin young man turns and walks away. A moment later, Maiko comes running back to you.
